items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Because I used to fire Maine Perez in there, and then that Maine Perez band, they had Gold Rule band, and then they had Butter Bowling band. I used to fire them, you see.

ctx.x: Yeah, nobody should play guitar in any of that bass. What was his last name, do you remember? His name was, it was, Auguste, Auguste's name was, you see, yeah. I believe his name was Auguste Phillip, I believe his name was, I believe it is, Auguste Phillip, yeah. And from there when I stole, the one day, I believe it was on a Sunday night, they had a supper home, and it was boys coming down and playing, and my boys playing, and they would take a fishing pool and make a flute I was playing, and my cousin Auguste…
Well, did you know any of the guys in these different bands? Did you know people in Perez's and the Golden Rule and Bowling?
